supportDesc.foliation: The manuscript was refoliated in pencil in the lower margin of each folio. The previous foliation was executed in pencil, probably by the book conservators, every fifth leaf in the lower right corner of each folio.
supportDesc.condition: The manuscript was rebound and professionally restored in Raimondo Milio's laboratory for the restoration, in Rome, in 2000. The back board is broken and repaired with three threads probably of vegetal origin. Both boards were probably reused, as they show an additional series of board holes on the outer sides of both boards. The leather cover is mostly detached from the boards. The sewing has been repaired in several places (see the center fold of ). is of slightly smaller size. Some leaves are slightly stained with dirt, e.g. on . Traces of intensive use. The parchment is torn on : some characters are lost or illegible.
